partsTasks.taskName: Submit Dealership Infrastructure Conversion Support Ticket
partsTasks.descriptionPlain: For any dealers identified for Centralized Name File (CNF), Centralized Accounting, Enterprise or Multi-Site configurations, raise a support ticket with needed structural and conversion requirements. Centralized Name File (CNF): This is a single name file shared across multiple dealerships/ rooftops/ Dealer IDs where all locations use the same customer and vendor database. Limit of one Centralized Name File per Tenant. If the current organization is not on a Central Name File/ Single Name File, the conversion team will need to be provided prefix or suffix logic by Dealer ID to be merged. (The recommendation is to provide suffixing logic as it simplifies the end-user experience when searching for Charge Customers or Vendors.) Tekion is unable to assist with customer or vendor merge as part of the Conversion. Centralized Accounting: If a group is implementing Centralized Accounting, the above logic for Centralized Name File must be provided to the conversion team. Centralized Name File is a requirement for Centralized Accounting. The Conversion team also needs to be notified to ensure the Centralized Accounting feature is enabled and APIs are run. Multi-Site (Sites): For this consolidated structure the Multi-Site approval process must be completed with unique Sites structural requirements identified (ie: shared/ separate parts inventory, shared/ separate used car inventory, etc.) Once verified, the conversion team must be provided with the details for how the data should be split by Site ID (included in the approval spreadsheet) and shared via a conversion support ticket. Enterprise: This is the customer's ability to have a single data base for employees and user management with additional features supporting enterprise level reporting and some other cross company features. The Enterprise blueprint must be completed as part of the enablement. For additional details around any of these features, please work with the Account Executive (AE) and Sales Engagement Manager (SEM) to coordinate demos and any contractual change requirements. Please note: Any late identification of these structural requirements will likely result in a launch date change and may incur additional fees.

partsTasks.taskName: Submit Dealership Infrastructure Conversion Support Ticket
partsTasks.descriptionPlain: For any dealers identified for Centralized Name File (CNF), Centralized Accounting, Enterprise or Multi-Site configurations, raise a support ticket with needed structural and conversion requirements. Centralized Name File (CNF): This is a single name file shared across multiple dealerships/ rooftops/ Dealer IDs where all locations use the same customer and vendor database. Limit of one Centralized Name File per Tenant. If the current organization is not on a Central Name File/ Single Name File, the conversion team will need to be provided prefix or suffix logic by Dealer ID to be merged. (The recommendation is to provide suffixing logic as it simplifies the end-user experience when searching for Charge Customers or Vendors.) Tekion is unable to assist with customer or vendor merge as part of the Conversion. Centralized Accounting: If a group is implementing Centralized Accounting, the above logic for Centralized Name File must be provided to the conversion team. Centralized Name File is a requirement for Centralized Accounting. The Conversion team also needs to be notified to ensure the Centralized Accounting feature is enabled and APIs are run. Multi-Site (Sites): For this consolidated structure the Multi-Site approval process must be completed with unique Sites structural requirements identified (ie: shared/ separate parts inventory, shared/ separate used car inventory, etc.) Once verified, the conversion team must be provided with the details for how the data should be split by Site ID (included in the approval spreadsheet) and shared via a conversion support ticket. Enterprise: This is the customer's ability to have a single data base for employees and user management with additional features supporting enterprise level reporting and some other cross company features. The Enterprise blueprint must be completed as part of the enablement. For additional details around any of these features, please work with the Account Executive (AE) and Sales Engagement Manager (SEM) to coordinate demos and any contractual change requirements. Please note: Any late identification of these structural requirements will likely result in a launch date change and may incur additional fees.
